title: The 3 Best Travel Backpacks for Backpacking Europe
h1: The 3 Best Travel Backpacks for Backpacking Europe
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for travel backpacks for backpacking europe, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel backpacks for backpacking europe using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 35L suitcase-style opening, 1000D TPU-coated polyester, recycled fabrics, Air-mesh back panel.
strengths: 35L sits closest to budget-carrier personal item limits among purpose-built travel packs
Suitcase-style opening suits repacking quietly in shared hostel rooms
Durable shell holds up over weeks of train stations and cobblestone streets
limitations: Even at 35L, some strict Ryanair-style sizers may still flag it at the gate
Thin hip belt offers less support than a hiking-style harness on long walking days
Limited external organization for quick-grab items like a passport or phone

products.name: Osprey Farpoint 40
products.blurb: Key specs: 40L with removable 11L daypack, LightWire frame suspension, Stowable harness.
strengths: Frame suspension and hipbelt carry weight better on long walks between train stations
Removable daypack works as a day bag for sightseeing without the main pack
Widely used by long-term backpackers, with a strong multi-year durability track record
limitations: 40L exceeds several budget-carrier personal item limits, may incur a gate fee
Two-piece system is bulkier than a single travel pack when both pieces are combined
Higher price than the Cotopaxi packs at typical retail

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 42L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 42L suitcase-style opening, 15-inch laptop sleeve, 1000D TPU-coated polyester shell.
strengths: Extra volume over the 35L version suits multi-month itineraries with fewer laundry stops
Same fast packing layout as the smaller Allpa, useful in shared hostel spaces
Durable shell fabric withstands repeated loading onto buses and trains
limitations: 42L is the least budget-carrier-friendly size in this list
Heavier than the 35L version when fully packed for a long trip
May need to be checked rather than carried as a free personal item on strict carriers

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
